summary: AngioDynamics filed an 8-K reporting the planned CEO transition: James C. Clemmer will retire as President and CEO (and board member) effective the earlier of November 30, 2026 or successor appointment, and the board appointed Eric Honroth, 55, most recently President Life Science at Getinge AB, as President, CEO and director effective November 2, 2026. An October 3, 2026 employment agreement governs his terms; the filing states no disagreement behind Clemmer's retirement and no related-party arrangements. Watch execution risk during the handoff and any strategic shift under new leadership.
